hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that deploys ERC20 tokens via a bonding curve on Uniswap v4, blocking external liquidity additions and removals. When the bonding curve supply is exhausted, it automatically migrates liquidity to a full-range AMM pool. Collects a 5% fee on swaps (1% creator, 1% platform, 3% protocol) distributed to configurable fee receivers via afterSwapReturnsDelta.
